title: Remove unused Splash.hpp include + refresh obsolete stub comments
why: Wiring audit: src/main.cpp:8 includes Splash.hpp but render_splash() is never called (only render_boot_animation). Comments on ble_adv_/wifi_ap_/ble_cent_ still say 'stub until v0.3' but they're fully wired now.
acceptance: no 'stub until v0.3' on shipped HALs

title: Migrate BleSpamApp / BleJammerApp / WifiBeaconFloodApp / DeauthApp to draw_text_styled
why: UI audit: these 4 apps still use legacy draw_text() instead of draw_text_styled(), so theme palette swaps don't affect their lines and font sizing is hard-coded.
acceptance: all renders use draw_text_styled with FontStyle::{Title,Body,Caption}

title: Standardize footer keybinding convention + trim overflow
why: UI audit: apps mix </>, <-/->, Up/Dn, Left/Right. DeauthApp footer is 62 chars (overflows 240px display). BleSpamApp/BleJammerApp footers have no keybinding hints. Pick one convention and apply.
acceptance: all footers use </> for L/R and ^/v for U/D

title: Fix 8 snprintf truncation warnings
why: Quality audit: format-truncation -Wformat-truncation= warnings on WifiApp/FilesApp/AprsMessageApp/Pineapple/MousejackApp. Most are real (long callsigns, deep paths, host strings) and should size buffers correctly or accept truncation explicitly.
acceptance: pio run -e cardputer_adv has zero -Wformat-truncation warnings (or each remaining is annotated as accepted)

title: Add tests for SubGhzCaptureReplayApp (most critical coverage gap)
why: Quality audit: 344-line app with capture/replay state machine + file I/O. We added 2 new tests in 4.13.2 but the app's tick() loop, frequency tuning, OOK modulation, save path, edge case handling all lack coverage.

title: Harmonize subtitle capitalization across radio_header users
why: UI audit: 'ACTIVE' / 'JAMMING' / 'OK' use different capitalization conventions in subtitles. Standardize to Title Case for consistency.

convention.format: Title Case (Active / Jamming / Ok / Partial / Missing)
